title: Internal shortages to be auctioned, client-wise (NSE Clearing, CM_SA_DTLS)
purpose: Client-wise detail of the internal shortages NSE Clearing auctions: the short-delivering client and the security. Name the file with CM_SA_DTLS in it and drop it on Exchange files.
source: NSE Clearing consolidated circular NCL/CMPT/73996 (CM segment), items 6.4 and 7.13-7.14 (auction of internal shortages: the valuation amount, settlement price plus 20%, is debited by 12:00 noon on the settlement day; no payment, no auction), and NCL/CMPT/71441 (375/2025) of 24 Nov 2025 (FAQs on internal shortage auctions). No published column layout was found: the file is read by its header names. When a real file's header differs, add its text as an alias here.
linked: Loaded on Settlement → Short deliveries: each client's internal shortage is matched to the short delivery recorded in Ledgerline, and the buyers of the security wait for the auctioned shares instead of a cash close-out.
